items.title: What Could Target (TGT) Gain From Surcharge Free ATMs In 2,000 Stores?
items.summary: Target (NYSE:TGT) will host surcharge-free ATMs from First Citizens Bank across roughly 2,000 U.S. stores through a new partnership. NCR Atleos is providing the ATM technology and services for the rollout as it moves forward with an acquisition by Brink's. The arrangement expands First Citizens Bank's surcharge-free access points inside a major national retailer for its cardholders.
